podcast.title: Formation with Ex-Members of Other Bands
podcast.body: Drummer Jeff Burrows, formerly of The Tea Party, joined Crash Karma, a band that also included ex-members from R.L.I.D.P., Somanova, and Edwin. This formation created a new collaborative project drawing from various established Canadian acts. "he joined a band called Crash Karma with ex-members of R.L.I.D.P. Sonoma the Earth Edwin as a matter of fact."

xref.title: Edwin Forms Crash Karma (2008)
xref.body: In 2008, Edwin partnered with Mike Turner (formerly of Our Lady Peace) and Jeff Burrows (of The Tea Party) to form the band Crash Karma. "Then in 2008, he joined up with Mike Turner, ex of our lady piece, and Jeff Burrows of the Tea Party in a band called Crash Karma."

xref.title: Post-I Mother Earth Collaborations
xref.body: After leaving I Mother Earth, Edwin collaborated with Christian Samson (drummer of Glüleg) and Ruben Huzenga (guitarist of Glüleg), who worked with him in his studio. He also became an ex-member who joined Crash Karma. "Christian Samson played around with Edwin after he left I Mother Earth."
